expressions.title: The Finance (Third Supplementary) Ordinance, 1972
expressions.title_basis: p1 (book p.415) prints 'THE FINANCE (THIRD SUPPLEMENTARY) ORDINANCE, 1972, Ordinance No. LXII of 1972 [28th December, 1972]', its preamble and ss.1-3; p2 (p.416) ends s.3 with clauses (c)-(d) (block 1593807). this PDF is three pages cut from a bound annual volume of the 1972 Ordinances (running heads '1972 : Ord. ...'). The Law Reforms (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1972 (p2) follows and the Economic Reforms Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972 starts at the foot of p2 and is cut off after its preamble.

expressions.title: The Law Reforms (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
expressions.title_basis: p2 blocks 1593808-1593809 print the title and Ordinance No. LXIII of 1972; s.1 names it; ss.1-2 complete; not held elsewhere in the corpus. The Economic Reforms Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972 that follows is cut off after its preamble and is set aside as apparatus.
